compilerRegeneration.explanation: The previous bundled archive was a hand-corrected, overbundled package. Providence regeneration preserved the authored XAP 97 and XAP 149 records and Simple Encounter 7 opcode 44 from the pinned source, while removing source-unexplained overbundled records and restoring the source-owned spell dependency.
